CustomField.formula:
/* uncomment next and last 2 lines to handle negatives and denote them in accounting style -1234 == (1,234.00) From - https://developer.salesforce.com/forums/?id=906F00000008utHIAQ */
IF(Order_Type__c <>'Credit', SUBSTITUTE( IF(Dollars__c < 0, "(", "") & /* uncomment and adjust currency sign */ "$" & IF(ABS(Dollars__c) >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(Dollars__c / 1000000)) & ",", "") & IF(ABS(Dollars__c) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Dollars__c/ 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Dollars__c)), 3) /* multiplier x100 and 2 indicate number of decimal places */ & "." & RIGHT(TEXT(ROUND(Dollars__c* 100, 0)), 2) & IF(Dollars__c< 0, ")", "") ,"-","") , SUBSTITUTE( IF(Dollars__c > 0, "(", "") & /* uncomment and adjust currency sign */ "$" & IF(ABS(Dollars__c) >= 1000000, TEXT(FLOOR(Dollars__c / 1000000)) & ",", "") & IF(ABS(Dollars__c) >= 1000, RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Dollars__c/ 1000)), 3) & ",", "") & RIGHT(TEXT(FLOOR(Dollars__c)), 3) /* multiplier x100 and 2 indicate number of decimal places */ & "." & RIGHT(TEXT(ROUND(Dollars__c* 100, 0)), 2) & IF(Dollars__c> 0, ")", "") ,"-","") )
CustomField.label: TotalDollarsPortal
